Product Quality & Audit Register
================================

### QUA-00000001-0037
Quality case QUA-00000001-0037 concerns HP EliteBook 640 G11, product code VLT-LAP-HP-640G11-32, received in Vadodara. Observed condition: configuration mismatch. Quantity affected: 12. Current state: pending.
Quality Assurance compared complaint samples, receiving records, serial ranges and supplier information. A model-level pattern is not assumed from one isolated unit. The exact product code and physical serials are retained separately so that a lot issue can be distinguished from a single-device defect.
Where corrective action is recommended, the action and verification criteria are recorded. A customer complaint may trigger a quality investigation but is not automatically proof of a supplier-wide failure.
